modelo_ou_modo: Imagem, Qualidade 2.0, x4, 4:3; edicoes pela caixa 'Descreva sua edicao'
prompt: a grassy cliff top with a red and white lighthouse with 5 characters: Trippa Troppa (green fish head on a chubby brown bear body) having a picnic on the grass; Cappuccino Assassino (striped coffee cup with a black ninja mask, little arms and legs in sneakers, holding two spoons, no knives) flying a kite; Girafa Celestre (round watermelon body with a small giraffe head and legs in brown boots) carrying a basket; Boneca Ambalabu (green frog head on a black tire with two human legs) playing a guitar; Bobrito Bandito (beaver in a striped suit and fedora, no weapons) playing with a ball. Around them: a checkered picnic blanket with sandwiches and fruit, a wooden staircase, flowers on the cliff, a kite in the sky, a small house with a blue door, a wooden fence, a bench, a telescope and fluffy clouds. wide shot, busy scene packed with small distinct objects over the whole picture, no empty areas, everything in sharp focus, all characters medium size and fully visible, cute, no weapons, no text, no logo, no watermark, 4:3, flat 2D cartoon illustration, thick clean black outlines, flat bright colors with simple cel shading, children's comic book style, crisp clear shapes

edicoes.prompt: Edit this image. Make exactly these changes and nothing else: 1) Make the black ninja mask of the striped coffee cup character on the left red. 2) Make the brown fedora hat of the beaver on the right blue. 3) Make the blue door of the small house on the right red. 4) Make the multicolored kite at the top center solid pink. 5) Replace the bunch of purple grapes at the left corner of the picnic blanket with a slice of watermelon of the same size. 6) Replace the large grey rock in the grass at the bottom center with an orange pumpkin of the same size. Keep the composition, camera, style, colors, lighting and every other detail exactly the same.

chapeu fedora do Bobrito Bandito marrom -> azul
pipa colorida do alto (centro) -> rosa lisa (o rabo de lacos continua colorido)

pedra cinza grande no capim (centro-baixo) -> abobora laranja

calca azul da Boneca Ambalabu -> amarela

notas: Rodada 1: as 4 candidatas tinham os 5 personagens; a 4 tinha a Trippa Troppa mais urso que peixe. Escolhida a 1: os 5 fieis (Cappuccino Assassino com 2 colheres, sem faca, empinando a pipa; Boneca Ambalabu sentada num pneu), farol, escada, cerca, banco, luneta e casa de porta azul. O mar aparece so a esquerda, ao fundo (sem tubarao, sem cena submarina). As duas edicoes fizeram as 6 mudancas, sem deslocar o enquadramento.
